evidence: Port replacement first observes focus, then sends platform-appropriate Meta+A on macOS (Ctrl+A elsewhere) and verifies the input selection bounds before Backspace or insertion.
Selection and clearing waits are deadline-bounded; an unsuccessful select-all assertion stops before destructive replacement input.
Offscreen target handling uses at most eight CDP mouse-wheel events and waits for observed movement; pointer actions follow only after viewport, hit-target, animation, and stability checks.
DOM reads are observational; no product state or storage is injected. No polling loop is unbounded.
engineering_review.syntax: node --check passed for both changed browser modules

acceptance_readiness.reason: The fix is runner-only and addresses both recorded interaction failures, but this peer review did not execute the genuine native Chrome panel retest. T46 worker rediscovery and T70 unavailable-API/alternate update outcomes remain explicitly unverified.
